about: Money for the dashboard's runway. Only the founder edits this file (the spend gate). Amounts are per month in the currency named here; null means not set. cash: money in the bank on as_of (YYYY-MM-DD). fixed_costs: recurring monthly costs such as tools, hosting and ads; AI spend comes from the cost log. one_offs: single payments in a month (YYYY-MM), positive for a cost, negative for money in.
